utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Can you hear me? Teams is showing the little spinning thing again.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah, you're through. Before we start, whose new car is that in the car park? Very shiny for this place.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Not mine. Mine's the one with more dust than paint.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Someone's parked it miles from everyone else. Give it a week.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Talking of optimism, we've planned a barbecue for the weekend. Weather forecast's changed three times already.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: So, barbecue under an umbrella. Standard British summer.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Exactly. Sausages in waterproofs.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, Wednesday 15 July. Let's get through the actual factory bit before the menu.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: First, we finished the repair on the PRV on the boiler last night. That's done.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah, saw that in the handover. Nice to have that one off the list.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, closed out, not another job for today.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: And I tested the fire alarm panel yesterday and it's all fine now. That testing's finished.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: I did hear a slight rattle from the fire panel, just so it's mentioned. Nothing to action yet.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: That's just the noise you're flagging, yeah? Not saying the alarm test failed?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: No, no. Just an observation, not reopening the test.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Same sort of thing with the GT1 compressor. Noticed it was running a bit warm on nights, but it settled down.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Okay, so that settled down, rather than something still climbing now.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah. As you say, an observation, not a new call-out.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: While we're on that equipment, I'll update the risk assessment for work on the GT1 compressor this afternoon. It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: You mean the work risk assessment, rather than making the warm-running observation into a separate job?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah, exactly. I'll update the existing risk assessment for the work. Not raising another job off the temperature comment.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Aisha. That's yours this afternoon, then, without treating it as urgent.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Um, my blocker hasn't moved. The supplier still hasn't confirmed the delivery for the line 1 mould temp.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: No confirmed delivery here either. There's nothing definite to put against it.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Right, still blocked. Not putting that down as work we can get through today.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Dave, can you clear the jam and check the sensors on the stretch wrapper by the end of the week? Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah, so both parts of that—clear the jam, then check the sensors, not just get it moving?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Both, please. The sensor check is part of the same job.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Okay, I'll clear the jam and check the sensors on the stretch wrapper by the end of the week. Normal priority, got it.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: The old 'it's moving, therefore it's fixed' approach doesn't count, then.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Sadly not. You've ruined my entire engineering philosophy.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And Dave, can you run a function test on the Compressed Air Dryer on the 3rd? It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Sorry, you clipped there. Function test on the Compressed Air Dryer, on the 3rd?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: That's right, on the 3rd. Not asking you to bring it forward.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yep, accepted. I'll run the function test on the Compressed Air Dryer on the 3rd. Important, but not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: So I've got Dave against the stretch wrapper by the end of the week, normal priority, and the Compressed Air Dryer on the 3rd, matters but isn't urgent.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: That's the pair, yeah.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Next gap: we need someone to book a contractor to look at the GT2 inlet valve.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: The booking needs doing on the 3rd. That's the wording I've got, on the 3rd.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right. Anyone able to take the contractor booking for the GT2 inlet valve?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: I can't commit to taking that one. Don't put it against me just because it says contractor.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: No, I can't take the booking either.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Still unallocated, then. Mentioning the date wasn't me volunteering, just to be clear.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood. Contractor booking for the GT2 inlet valve, on the 3rd, still needs doing and has no owner.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: There's another uncovered one: the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the fire panel needs doing at half two.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Just—sorry, over you. My fire alarm panel test yesterday isn't that sign-off, and I'm not taking the sign-off by mentioning the test.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah, separate thing entirely. Yesterday's test is done; this sign-off still needs someone.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Can anyone take the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the fire panel at half two?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: I can't take that one.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Nor me. Don't want a nod on a call being read as me accepting it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fair enough. No owner for the fire panel sign-off at half two, then. It remains uncovered, not agreed to anybody.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Two unowned items: book the contractor for the GT2 inlet valve on the 3rd, and the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the fire panel at half two.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: And the slight rattle isn't a third item. Still just an observation, nothing to action yet.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep. Same for the warm-running comment that settled down. Let's not turn every line in the conversation into another job.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: My actual commitment is the risk assessment for work on the GT1 compressor. I'll update it this afternoon; it matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: And I've accepted the stretch wrapper jam and sensors by the end of the week, normal priority, plus the Compressed Air Dryer function test on the 3rd, not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: The line 1 mould temp stays in the blocked bit. No delivery confirmation, not a fresh action out of this call.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, that's clear. Accepted work, unowned gaps, blocked item. Not all one big cheerful list.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Excellent. Back to the important issue: whoever owns that new car has clearly never met our car park.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Still reckon it's a visitor. Nobody here would risk something that clean.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, that'll do. Thanks, everyone. We've got the commitments clear and the two gaps are explicitly unowned. End it there.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Cheers, all.
